concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` but writes to a shared project‑owned file (`data/raw/contract_hashes.json`). Parallel execution with other `[P]` tasks that also write to shared files could cause race conditions.

Task T002 is marked `[P]` yet creates/overwrites `data/raw/tasks.json`, `data/raw/skills.json`, and `data/raw/checksums.json`. These files are also accessed by other `[P]` tasks, making parallel safety questionable.
Task T003 is marked `[P]` but rewrites `data/raw/checksums.json`, a file also written by T002. Concurrent runs could corrupt the checksum record.

Task T006 is marked `[P]` but appends rows to `data/results/experiment_log.csv` and creates JSON‑L logs in a shared directory. Parallel instances would contend for the same CSV file, violating parallel‑safety.
